tasks.title: Configuration and common types
tasks.acceptance: Every canonical TOML key loads; relative paths resolve from repository root; test directory overrides do not alter policy hash; FrozenClock preserves UTC microseconds.

tasks.title: Canonical schemas and protected writes
tasks.acceptance: Annual and Q4 coexist; same-key same-value append is a no-op; same-key different-value raises ImmutableConflict; UPDATE and DELETE of protected rows fail; both databases enable foreign keys.

tasks.title: Trading calendar and execution clock
tasks.acceptance: Weekend resolution uses supplied sessions; next execution is strictly after generation date; missing session range is refused; no network or implicit clock in Calendar. Future publication dates are refused by the runner in WS11.

tasks.title: Run lifecycle and ledger recovery
tasks.acceptance: One failed attempt leaves no partial cohort; run status/error survives; journal inserts and control updates replay in sequence; changed before hash fails replay; restored tables and ledger_events match source.

tasks.title: Offline fixtures, CLI and check runner
tasks.acceptance: All external transport is disabled by default; fixture seed 0 repeats byte-identically; source/event fixtures use explicit known_at; CLI help and error codes work; default collection includes the two unchanged legacy test modules.

tasks.title: Constituent parsing and capture archive
tasks.acceptance: Accept five required headers and special-character symbols; reject duplicate ISIN/symbol and malformed/short live lists; stale fallback retains original observed_at; an unchanged freshly fetched checksum is allowed.

tasks.title: Identity and tracking to every maturity
tasks.acceptance: A same-ISIN rename keeps security_id; changed ISIN needs a separate identity; removed member remains tracked from cohorts even before any labels exist; retain it while any of six horizons or a paper order remains open.

tasks.title: Sector rules and point-in-time groups
tasks.acceptance: FS stays unsplit initially; explicit small-sector merges apply at membership date; unknown sector becomes UNCLASSIFIED; future reclassification cannot change old cohort groups; no decisionless taxonomy changes.

tasks.title: Throttled client, archive and units
tasks.acceptance: Fake client records >=0.5s between accessor calls and >=1s between batches; threads=False; 429 retry uses injected sleep120 without real waits; None stays missing; debtToEquity357 ->3.57; dividendRate75/price5300; archive exact returned bytes/metadata.

tasks.title: Bitemporal statements and TTM
tasks.acceptance: Read annual100 and Q425 separately at one fiscal end; a later150 revision is invisible at prior cutoff; estimated lag never bypasses fetched_at; eight consecutive quarters required for TTM offset4; absent earlier-year quarters yield NaN.

tasks.title: Holdings, attributes and capture command
tasks.acceptance: Current run capture is invisible to previous cutoff; lag 3 needs four distinct monthly captures; latest same-month capture wins before cutoff; sector text is stored only in attributes; command archives raw price responses but does not claim C03 integration until WS11.

tasks.title: Price schema, basis normalization and TRI
tasks.acceptance: Call the canonical price DDL; delivered split-adjusted close/volume normalize exactly as the oracle; unknown basis refuses; split600->100 ratio6 has TRI100->100; dividend100->90 plus10 has TRI100->100; no extra split term on already normalized input.

tasks.title: Reconciliation, quarantine and decisions
tasks.acceptance: Changed historical vendor bytes preserve old vintage; unexplained revisions remain quarantined; actor/decision mismatch refuses acceptance; action correction appends; approved resolution never mutates factor_values or scores.

tasks.title: Monthly panels, benchmarks and archive recovery
tasks.acceptance: Panel uses cohort source refs and actual ADV; gross EW equals manual constituent gross returns; missing optional index is unavailable; restore cache from archived vintage; a changed re-download fails manifest verification and leaves committed hashes intact.

tasks.title: Field bounds and drift
tasks.acceptance: Invalid yield3.49 is masked only in a copy; actual source stays3.49; fixed-bin PSI handles empty/zero bins with documented epsilon1e-6 and reports missing; first baseline is DEFERRED, not fabricated history.

tasks.title: Pre-computation gates
tasks.acceptance: G1-G7 use captured provenance and configured denominators; fresh unchanged membership passes G2; no pre-cutoff fundamentals blocks bootstrap; record all gates before raising Blocked.

tasks.title: Post-compute coverage and replay callbacks
tasks.acceptance: G8 uses actual calculated NaNs with financial applicability excluded from denominator; >=3 excluded actives blocks; callback absent is implementation failure; first-month historical replay is legitimately DEFERRED; failed staging writes no published scores.

tasks.title: Restricted FactorInputs
tasks.acceptance: Physically filtered inputs expose no connection/client/labels; future or undeclared fields raise LookaheadError; each result records exact observation refs; old as_of gets same data after a future revision.

tasks.title: Centered bounded ranks
tasks.acceptance: Match every golden z within 1e-12; tied values stay tied; constant group is NaN; mean0 and abs<=3 for finite groups; do not assert unit variance; negative direction is applied once.

tasks.title: Price factors and diagnostics
tasks.acceptance: Geometric TRI fixes momentum endpoints;253 bars required for 252 returns; sample shortage produces flags; beta uses aligned index returns; dc_flag is diagnostic only; size reads captured mcap and is not backfillable.

tasks.title: Fundamental and flow factors
tasks.acceptance: All launch formulas match MASTER_SPEC5.3; nonfinancial exclusions, nonpositive denominators, missing quarters and fiscal alignment are tested; low accruals gets higher oriented z; no default growth or ROE.

tasks.title: Registry, provenance and sector features
tasks.acceptance: Sync rejects changed code/helper hashes without affected version bumps; registered future hypotheses stay out of earlier cohorts; controls use valid lifecycle shadow; compute returns staging rows only; sector features use frozen groups.

tasks.title: Exact integer family weights
tasks.acceptance: Match expected units and sum10000; common finite evidence intersection determines N; below 12 matured3M rows returns EW; all nonpositive means return EW even with gate open; bounds hold across2..14 families; repeats are identical.

tasks.title: Hierarchical and flat composites, coverage and screens
tasks.acceptance: Flat mode equals direct finite-factor mean and differs from hierarchical in an unbalanced family fixture; probation has half status weight; financial non-applicability is excluded; MOM_ONLY may score from one family; illiquid names remain stored but ineligible.

tasks.title: Versioned model staging and invariants
tasks.acceptance: Score every initialized model using frozen definitions and explicitly supplied history; current registry changes do not alter old version; same draft repeats identical hashes; challenger cannot change champion role without decision; valid promoted challenger need not equal EW.

tasks.title: Cohort labels and appended corrections
tasks.acceptance: Original cohort member count survives index dropout; no row before endpoint; missing quote is not automatically delisted; action resolution appends group-wide affected revisions; old rows unchanged; live/backfill same-date labels remain separate.

tasks.title: Statistical functions and oriented metrics
tasks.acceptance: Match hand-computed HAC gamma0/gamma1/se; short/constant vectors return unavailable uncertainty; oriented low-is-good signal IC+1; constant Spearman is None; paired tests use same cohorts; positive/negative raw signs are not applied twice.

tasks.title: Revision selection and causal training history
tasks.acceptance: Monthly window keys use empty strings; unchanged evaluation inserts0; revised evidence appends with supersedes; select exactly one latest-known revision before status filtering; no future endpoint, later revision or backfill enters family fitting; do not compress calendar gaps for HAC.

tasks.title: Leakage suite and stored-history curves
tasks.acceptance: Run T1-T10 from the test plan with explicit prerequisites; deterministic planted rank matches exactIC; moving publication dates cannot bypass capture time; no production edits during injections; learning curves read original stored weights; missing bands display unavailable.

tasks.title: Backfill replay and warmup accounting
tasks.acceptance: Replay only price/volume factors with warmup; no current mcap or statements; record requested/actual date counts and survivorship caveat; negative measured backfill is accepted as an outcome, not adjusted to force positivity.

tasks.title: Construction and cost arithmetic
tasks.acceptance: Bucket boundaries are inclusive as specified; rank45 retained/rank61 removed; sector cap skips entrants; bucketC <=.02 and infeasible residual goes to cash; ties byID; .10 weight B trade costs.00037.

tasks.title: Pending orders, dated fills and NAV
tasks.acceptance: Orders cannot fill before actual eligible close; repeated settlement adds no fill; NAV spans actual event dates with no pre-inception returns; factor/model cohort TOP_Q20 and MATCHED_EW books include entry and exit costs, remain pending when prices are missing and provide frozen selection evidence.

tasks.title: Matched benchmarks, spreads and scoreboard
tasks.acceptance: Compare net with net using identical universe/execution; matched EW minus itself is0; cost events inside full interval are summed; no simulated quintile book means unavailable net spread; no forced TOP30-turnover-below-DEC10 inequality; IR absent below 24 portfolio months.

tasks.title: Recorded bootstrap and hypothesis budget
tasks.acceptance: Seed only exact launch definitions with system/spec-hash decision, idempotently; no fake human or Tier2 approval; annual seventh and family fourth registration refused; launch exemption does not exclude hypotheses from reported trial counts; first cutoff is after registration.

tasks.title: Criteria and fixed review opportunities
tasks.acceptance: Decision vectors test each criterion independently; positive oriented IC is good for both raw directions; use the single look-adjusted t_crit and cumulative trial count; factor looks are 12/24/36 and model looks 24/36/48, consumed once even when ancillary criteria fail; unavailable cost/ablation is unmet; model review consumes the same paired interval.

tasks.title: Approval, ratification and prospective changes
tasks.acceptance: LLM actor plus human prefix refused; Tier2 refused; Tier1 criteria all true yields provisional; human ratifies; expiry appends reversion and prospective model version; failed reversion blocks next publication; original scores unchanged; ADR exists for every applied decision.

tasks.title: Reports and knowledge mirrors
tasks.acceptance: Render persisted evidence only; separate tracks, originally-published vs revised view, actual cutoff/generated times and pending orders; preserve content-addressed report manifests with exact references and frozen control summaries; reproduce an old report after later revisions; finite band required only when status says estimable; include ratifications and phase-specific acceptance, no unmeasured performance claims.

tasks.title: Source inventory and fixture extraction
tasks.acceptance: Open source mode=ro; record SHA256/counts; extract20 known tickers into temporary fixture; dry-run changes neither database nor files; mismatched source facts are reported and never repaired in legacy DB.

tasks.title: Cohort mapping, factors and models
tasks.acceptance: Six snapshot-map records, four published full legacy cohorts,1997 rows/model on fullsource; two legacy models and 11factor fields; use raw original values for attribution; flags preserve known defects; no legacy inputs become clean live facts.

tasks.title: Attribution and migration repeatability
tasks.acceptance: Fullsource legacy-quote attribution within.01 of red-team table; adjusted result shown separately without enforced sign; irregular adjacent periods are not h1 labels; second migration is unchanged0; source SHA256 remains identical; factual system ADRs only.

tasks.title: Monthly orchestration and recovery
tasks.acceptance: Test MASTER_SPEC9.1 step order: settle/mature/evaluate before fit; lock and publication precheck; coldstart BLOCKED no scores; pre-cutoff capture allows later publication; crash before publish leaves no cohort; retry and concurrent start cannot duplicate; failed scores still produce earlier labels/report.

tasks.title: Offline UI and evidence export
tasks.acceptance: Eight tabs work offline with empty/blocked/live/legacy states; output no numeric inference without uncertainty status; reject missing band labeled estimable; show generation/exec dates and pending orders; no console errors or font/CDN requests.

tasks.title: Verification, scheduling script and owner documentation
tasks.acceptance: Sign-off prints engineering/operational/longitudinal separately with PASS/FAIL/DEFERRED; real checks on isolated DB and frozen source; persisted report reproduces old evidence even after revisions; cron script only, no schedule installed; root docs distinguish unchanged legacy invariants from V2; no automatic pushes.
